status: frozen before any Granite Vision benchmark result or AttnRes adaptation launch
purpose: Replace the stopped InternVL refinement with one architecture-transfer test on a genuinely different Granite decoder, using one fixed recipe and a seed-0 promotion gate.

model_selection.reason: Apache-2.0 standard llava_next checkpoint with a 40-layer Granite text decoder; it is neither Qwen nor Llama and is directly supported by the architecture-light decoder hook.

seed0_matrix.schedule: starts after the final bounded InternVL evaluation exits

run_seeds_1_and_2_only_if: seed-0 RSM exceeds seed-0 matched Full AttnRes by at least 0.15 percentage points
three_seed_acceptance: mean paired RSM-minus-Full gain is at least 0.15 percentage points
mean RSM macro exceeds Frozen Base
at least two of three paired seed deltas are positive
promotion_gate.failure_policy: Report Granite as a failed architecture-transfer test and stop replacing models; do not search another Granite recipe.

material_passport.evaluation_data: local lmms-eval caches for the six formal VLM tasks
material_passport.hardware: node42 GPUs 2, 3, and 6 for seed-0; GPU 7 excluded
